# Vendored front-end assets (offline copies, no build step)

Downloaded once, unmodified, so the demo works without internet access.

| File | Source | Licence |
|---|---|---|
| `tailwind-play-3.4.16.js` | https://cdn.tailwindcss.com/3.4.16 (Tailwind CSS Play CDN) | MIT |
| `d3-7.9.0.min.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3@7.9.0/dist/d3.min.js | ISC |
| `plot-0.6.16.umd.min.js` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@observablehq/plot@0.6.16/dist/plot.umd.min.js | ISC |
| `fonts/inter-latin-*.woff2` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/inter@5.1.0/files/ | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono-latin-*.woff2` | https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@fontsource/jetbrains-mono@5.1.0/files/ | SIL Open Font License 1.1 |

The Tailwind Play script prints a "should not be used in production" warning in the
browser console; that is expected for a no-build research demo.
